title: Telemachus Mentoring Programme 2027 (Global Thinkers Forum)
organization: Global Thinkers Forum (GTF), a London-based non-profit
overview: Eight-month mentoring programme that pairs young people aged 18 to 29 from around the world with volunteer mentors (the parallel Athena track is for women of any age above 22). Mentees also join the wider Global Thinkers Forum community.
program_dates: 2027 cycle; mentoring runs 'over a period of eight months'. Start date not stated on the official pages read.
deadline_text: 'Applications for the 2027 Telemachus & Athena Mentoring Programmes Are Now Open!' 'Applications deadline: November 23, 2026'.
funding_details: The official pages read state neither a fee nor any financial support. Mentors volunteer their time.
eligibility: Telemachus: 'a young individual between 18-29' (official home page)
Applicants with a Bachelor's degree or at least five years of relevant professional experience are prioritised
Detailed eligibility criteria are linked from the application page but were not readable
nationality_requirements: No nationality restriction stated; mentees are youth 'from around the world'
application_process: Complete the online form on globalthinkersmentors.org/mentees-application by 23 November 2026

sources.label: Global Thinkers Mentors home (eligibility, eight-month duration, organiser)
Opportunity Desk listing (mentions an optional three-month GTF internship; not confirmed on the official pages)

eligibility_reason: The stated criteria (age 18 to 29, Bachelor's degree prioritised, fluent English) match the profile's age band, degree and languages. The detailed criteria page and any fee could not be read, so the verdict stays at possibly eligible.
potential_issues: Format, fee and start date are not stated on the official pages read
The optional GTF internship is reported only by an aggregator
A mentoring programme, not a funded mobility
benefits: One-to-one mentoring for eight months by an experienced professional
Membership of the Global Thinkers Forum community
relevance_reason: Open worldwide to 18-29 year olds with a degree, so accessible, and a mentor can help with fellowship and master's applications. It brings no travel or funding.
action: If a mentor would help, fill in the mentees form by 23 November 2026. Stop if the form asks for any payment, and note the start date it gives.
notes: Found as a feed lead (Opportunity Desk, 30 October 2026). The organiser's home page still carries the 2026 heading; the 2027 call and deadline are on the application page.
